label: DreaMS similarity
note: Similarity of the DreaMS top hit (annotation pilot). Range 0-1 assumed: DreaMS similarity is a cosine of embeddings, theoretically -1 to 1; the pilot data lies in 0.44-0.97.

label: SIRIUS approximate confidence
note: SIRIUS (COSMIC) approximate confidence, 0-1 (annotation pilot). Four SIRIUS annotations have -Infinity in the source and carry no value (term table T067).

label: correlation p-value
note: p-value of the gene-metabolite correlation (paired-omics pilot). Theoretical range 0-1; a log scale needs a lower end above 0, so 1e-10 is used as the floor and smaller values get the end colour. The pilot seems filtered at p < 0.05.
